sources.role: Official publisher source for route records, exact ordered trip stop sequences, stable stop_code/codParada identities, stop names and structured coordinates.

sources.name: Frozen Málaga citywide source prefetch
sources.role: Owner-approved source authority for snapshot choice, stable identity rule, canonical exact sequences, loop decisions, settlement assignment, zero-trip route policy and component architecture.

sources.name: Ayuntamiento de Málaga - Líneas y paradas autobuses EMT
sources.role: Independent municipal corroboration that GTFS stop_code equals rider-facing codParada.

transformations.description: Uses the complete official EMT stop_code/codParada as the stable Málaga StopNode suffix and creates a same-code singleton StopPlace for each new identity.
Serializes all 8 frozen distinct exact GTFS sequences for routes 3, 11 and N1, including 2 source-supported contiguous short-working variants; no variants are flattened.
Applies the frozen loop registry exactly. None of the eight patterns in this component closes a loop, so no last-to-first edge is added.
Creates the owner-approved canonical es-malaga settlement identity and computes only this package-local center/bounds from the 102 routed official GTFS coordinates with deterministic framing padding.
Adds exactly one catalog descriptor and recomputes asset and aggregate SHA-256 values from final serialized bytes.

warnings: The municipal Google Transit ZIP is the frozen topology authority for this snapshot. NAP metadata observed for the same network reports a different trip/calendar snapshot and remains provenance-only because its bytes were not downloaded.
All 102 component coordinates are Grade B official structured municipal GTFS values; no coordinates are inferred or interpolated.
StopNode.sourceReferences is empty because no genuine OpenStreetMap platform or stop_position object was reconciled.
All 102 target stop identities are new in this first Málaga component. Later Málaga components must exact-copy these accepted StopNode and StopPlace objects whenever IDs recur.
Routes CC, L and 20E are preserved in the frozen citywide source registry but excluded from passenger topology because the captured municipal snapshot contains zero trips for them.
